rule.statement: The court held that what was transferred by Deed P15 was only house H5 and the land covered thereby together with the road reservation.
rule.supporting_quote: What was transferred by Deed P15 was only house H5 and the land covered thereby together with the road reservation, as described in Schedule 1, and that Lots 6 and 7, described respectively in Schedules 2 and 3, were included merely to properly identify and explain the subject matter of the transfer set out in Schedule 1.
